message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout, and my friend Jess went full panic mode. I pulled out my trusty lantern and power bank, while she was frantically searching for candles, which I reminded her could be a fire hazard. We ended up playing cards by lantern light, and it turned into a cozy evening filled with laughter instead of worry. It’s amazing how being a little prepared can turn a potential crisis into a fun memory. Do you have a 'panicker' friend too?
